user.title: Add a DDP pixel controller
user.description: Enter the controller's address. Home Assistant asks the controller for its output layout and checks which kind of controller it is. If it can't tell, you'll enter the pixel count yourself. DDP has no acknowledgement, so setup can only check that a socket opens. Nothing is sent to the lights.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the controller (UDP port 4048).

controller.title: Controller type
controller.description: Detected controller: {detected}. A vendor controller type adds a Scenes light for the controller's built-in effects and presets. Generic DDP creates only the per-output DDP lights.

data_description.controller_type: Choose Generic DDP if the detected type is wrong or you only want the DDP lights.

manual.title: Describe the strip
manual.description: The controller did not report a usable layout. One light covering the whole strip will be created.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the controller
reconfigure.description: Detected controller: {detected}. Changing the host keeps the device and its lights. Changing the type adds or removes the Scenes light; the DDP lights are kept.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the controller (UDP port 4048).
data_description.controller_type: Generic DDP creates only the per-output DDP lights.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a UDP socket to the controller. Check the host.
error.invalid_config: The host or pixel count is not valid for DDP.

data_description.brightness_cap: Maximum output as a percent of full. Every frame is capped, including effects.
data_description.color_order: Channel order the pixels expect on the wire.
data_description.fps: Frames per second for animated effects.
data_description.keepalive: Re-send the current frame this often, in seconds, so the controller doesn't fall back to its built-in effect (the NDB-Pro does after about 20 s without DDP). 0 turns it off; otherwise at least 0.5.

controller_failed.message: Could not command the controller for {entity}: {error}

not_a_controller.message: {entity} is not a controller Scenes light; recall_preset works only on a Scenes light.

socket_failed.message: Cannot open a DDP socket to {host}: {error}

unknown_controller_type.message: Unknown controller type {type}. Reconfigure the entry or upgrade the integration.

controller_unreachable.message: The controller at {host} did not answer: {error}

not_a_ddp_light.message: {entity} is a controller Scenes light; set_pattern works only on a DDP output light or All outputs.

effect_without_colors.message: Effect {effect} takes no colors, so it cannot show a pattern. Effects that can: {effects}

palette_not_a_controller.message: {entity} is not a controller Scenes light; set_colors works only on a Scenes light.

recall_preset.name: Recall preset
recall_preset.description: Plays one of the controller's 20 stored show presets (1-10 are Show 1, 11-20 Show 2). DDP segment lights are turned off so the controller's scene shows.

set_pattern.name: Set pattern
set_pattern.description: Shows a repeating pattern of colors on a DDP light, rendered by an effect (palette by default: fixed blocks of the colors). The pattern is kept across restarts; a later color replaces it.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: 1 to 16 RGB colors, each a list of red, green, blue from 0 to 255, for example [[255, 0, 0], [0, 255, 0]].

block_size.name: Block size
block_size.description: Pixels per color block. 1 with two colors is every other pixel. Only effects with blocks (palette) take it.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: The effect that renders the colors. Effects that take a single color use the first one.

params.name: Effect parameters
params.description: Other parameters of the effect, for example {"speed": 4} for chase.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness from 1 to 255. Leave empty to keep the light's brightness.

set_colors.name: Set colors
set_colors.description: Sets the colors the controller's built-in effects use (its palette of 5 custom colors), on a controller Scenes light. The light need not be on, and DDP lights keep the pixels. No colors clears the palette, so the controller picks random colors.

colors.name: Colors
colors.description: 0 to 5 colors for palette slots 1 to 5; the remaining slots are emptied. Each is a list of red, green, blue from 0 to 255, or cool_white or warm_white for the controller's white LEDs, for example ["warm_white", [255, 0, 0]]. An empty list clears the palette, so the controller picks random colors.

background.name: Background
background.description: The background color as red, green, blue from 0 to 255, for effects that use one. Leave empty to keep it.
